review_text: We ordered donuts from this shop through a delivery app. The delivery was quick and the donuts arrived in good condition. All the items we ordered were complete, with no mistakes or missing donuts. The donuts tasted really good. The donuts are soft, fresh, and flavorful. We were very happy with the quality and service. Overall, it was a great experience and we will surely order again. Highly recommended if you are looking for tasty donuts and fast delivery.
Kuddos to sir Michael for such an outstanding service! ☺️
